propositions: A live Gerrit dogfood probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the review-phase-boundaries criterion from the repository and executes it end-to-end without blocking contributors.

Four sequential patchsets test criterion execution: positive control (discovery/evidence refinement), historical severity-only stimulus, predeclared RP-F2 FIRE control (proof of project attribution), and cleaned final revision.

The project-attributed finding from the FIRE-control patchset must carry reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries] with Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 priority/decision recorded.
Blocking remains disabled (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.90) throughout the probe; threshold calibration and blocking enablement are deferred to a separate data-backed posture ticket.
The dogfood is observational only; discovered rubric or seam defects are captured as separate bugs and fixed independently; only the cleaned final patchset is submitted to main.
